title: Four lines, every time
author: Elena Ionescu
body:
Forty-one postcards. I counted them after he died.

From Sibiu, from Brașov, from a petrol station outside Deva, from a hospital in Cluj where he spent six days and told nobody. Always the same four lines: what the weather was doing, whether the food was any good, a question about the dog, and then: everything is in order here.

We found the last one in his jacket pocket. It was addressed to my son, who is three, and it had not been posted yet.
